summary.title: Escala
summary.description: Threat model of Escala (LABDSOF 2026/27). Summarised on Confluence page 09 · Security and Privacy Assessment. Threats T-01 to T-14 match page 09.

diagrams.title: 1 · Application data flow
diagrams.description: Users, services, data stores and external services of Escala in one environment (dev, QA or production).

threats.title: T-01 · Mocked sign-in lets anyone pick a privileged user
threats.description: With mocked sign-in, anyone with the link picks the supervisor or admin user. Components: web, escala-api.
threats.mitigation: Only synthetic data while sign-in is mocked; roles still checked on every endpoint; real authentication before any real data. Accepted for the MVP (§6.6 footnote). SCRUM-63.

threats.title: T-01 · Mocked sign-in lets anyone pick a privileged user
threats.description: With mocked sign-in, anyone with the link picks the supervisor or admin user. Components: web, escala-api.
threats.mitigation: Only synthetic data while sign-in is mocked; roles still checked on every endpoint; real authentication before any real data. Accepted for the MVP (§6.6 footnote). SCRUM-63.

threats.title: T-03 · Member acts on someone else's shift
threats.description: A member edits the request to swap or free someone else's shift, or to accept a cover for their own slot.
threats.mitigation: The server takes the member from the session, never from the request body, and checks that the shift is theirs; accepting a cover for one's own slot is refused. Tests with SCRUM-68 and SCRUM-73.

threats.title: T-06 · Member or supervisor denies an action
threats.description: A member says they never accepted a swap or cover; a supervisor says they never published a change.
threats.mitigation: Append-only audit records with who, what and when. TC-SCRUM-69-04.

threats.title: T-08 · Member reads other members' data
threats.description: A member reads other members' contacts, unavailability or cover balance through the API.
threats.mitigation: Responses to members carry only names and functions of others; no reason field; contacts and cover balance only for the owner. Tests with SCRUM-67 and SCRUM-82.

threats.title: T-12 · Privileged endpoints or prompt injection
threats.description: A member calls supervisor or admin endpoints directly; a message to the AI tries to make the model act (prompt injection).
threats.mitigation: Role checked on the server (403); the model runs with no tools in an empty folder, returns only the period schema, and the member confirms every proposal. TC-SCRUM-63-02, TC-SCRUM-75-01.

threats.title: T-04 · Two members take the same cover
threats.description: Two members accept the same cover at once and both are placed in the slot.
threats.mitigation: Only the first stored answer takes the slot (transaction with a uniqueness constraint). TC-SCRUM-73-02.

threats.title: T-02 · Fake messages published to the broker
threats.description: A process on the network publishes fake eligibility results or requests to the broker.
threats.mitigation: Broker reachable only inside the cluster; one broker user per service, allowed only on its own queues (infra/rabbitmq/setup.sh; internal service only). No test yet.

threats.title: T-05 · Wrong certification lets an unqualified member drive
threats.description: A wrong or altered certification lets an unqualified member drive.
threats.mitigation: Only the admin edits certifications; every change is audited; the worker re-checks validity at the shift date (RN03). SCRUM-77, TC-SCRUM-69-02.

threats.title: T-10 · IPMA or the AI slow or down
threats.description: IPMA or the AI is slow or down and blocks the supervisor or the member.
threats.mitigation: Timeouts; IPMA shows the last value with its age; AI off by flag or after 10 s falls back to the form. TC-SCRUM-75-03, TC-SCRUM-76-02.

threats.title: T-11 · AI usage limit exhausted
threats.description: Many AI requests use up the subscription's usage limit, so the AI stops for everyone.
threats.mitigation: At most 10 AI requests per member per hour (configurable); the form always works without the AI. Test with SCRUM-75.

threats.title: T-12 · Privileged endpoints or prompt injection
threats.description: A member calls supervisor or admin endpoints directly; a message to the AI tries to make the model act (prompt injection).
threats.mitigation: Role checked on the server (403); the model runs with no tools in an empty folder, returns only the period schema, and the member confirms every proposal. TC-SCRUM-63-02, TC-SCRUM-75-01.

threats.title: T-14 · Backups lost with the cluster
threats.description: The nightly pg_dump files are kept on a volume in the same cluster as the databases, so losing the node loses the databases and the backups.
threats.mitigation: In place: nightly backups kept 7 days on their own volume. Recommended: copy them outside the cluster (another host or object storage), or record the risk as accepted for the academic demonstration.

threats.title: T-07 · Free text with a health detail leaks
threats.description: Free text with a health or family detail leaks through logs, the dead-letter queue or the AI provider.
threats.mitigation: Free text never logged; deleted on confirmation or after 24 h; dead-letter messages deleted after 7 days; only text and reference date sent to the model; synthetic text only in demonstrations. TC-SCRUM-75-04.

diagrams.title: 2 · Delivery and operations
diagrams.description: How code reaches the cluster (GitOps with Argo CD) and how the team operates it (observability, port-forward).

threats.title: T-09 · Secret committed to the repository
threats.description: A secret (database, broker or CLI login) is committed to the repository.
threats.mitigation: Sealed Secrets only in Git; secret scanner in CI that fails the build (RNF07): not implemented yet (Diogo Costa).

threats.title: T-13 · Brute force on exposed admin UIs
threats.description: Argo CD (escala-argocd.duckdns.org) and Grafana (escala-grafana.duckdns.org) are reachable from the Internet with a password login; a guessed or default password gives control of deployments or access to logs.
threats.mitigation: In place: TLS on both hosts; Grafana admin credentials in a Sealed Secret and sign-up turned off. Recommended: change the initial Argo CD admin password and delete its secret, and restrict both UIs by IP allow-list or single sign-on.
